member.name: T:Jellyfin.Plugin.JellyTTV.LiveTvGuideRefresher
member.summary: Background service that polls the JellyTTV backend for live channel changes and triggers Jellyfin's "Refresh Guide" scheduled task whenever the set of live channels changes, so Live TV reflects go-live/go-offline events without a manual guide refresh.
member.remarks: The task is executed in-process through rather than by POSTing to /ScheduledTasks/Running/RefreshGuide. That endpoint requires an admin token, so the HTTP approach returned 401; going through the task manager needs no credentials and is unaffected by bind address, HTTPS or a reverse proxy.

member.name: T:Jellyfin.Plugin.JellyTTV.TwitchResultsHandler
member.summary: Results handler invoked by the Home Screen Sections plugin to populate the "Live on Twitch" section. HSS creates instances via DI (ActivatorUtilities).
member.remarks: This deliberately returns real LiveTvChannel items from Jellyfin's library rather than synthetic ones. Home Screen Sections offers no supported way for a third-party plugin to attach an external image url to a card — ImageTags values must be real image hashes, and HSS's own Jellyseerr sections only render remote posters because its bundled client script special-cases them. Synthetic items also carry ids that resolve to nothing, which makes the web client's card builder throw mid-render and collapses the whole modular home layout. Using genuine library items gives us working artwork (sourced from the playlist's tvg-logo), in-app playback and favourites for free.
